definitions.short: properly, to bind firmly , i.e. (by implication) to be (causatively to make ) plump ; also (through the figurative sense of dumbness) to dream
definitions.usage: (cause to) dream(-er), be in good liking, recover.
definitions.full: H2492. chalam I. [ חָלַם ] verb be healthy, strong (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic Ethpe`el be made healthy, strong , Aph`el causative, also derivatives; חֲלַם press firmly together ) — Qal Imperfect בְנֵיהֶם יַחְלְמוּ Job 39:4 their young are healthy. Hiph`il Imperfect 2masculine singular וְתַחֲלִימֵנִי Isa 38:16 and restore me to health (|| וְהַחֲיֵ֫ינִי ). II. חָלַם verb dream (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic , חֲלַם ; Ethiopic Arabic , dream, experience an emission of the seminal fluid, attain to puberty ) — Qal Perfect ׳ח Gen 42:9 ; Dan 2:1 , חָלַמְתִּי Gen 37:9 3 t., חָלָ֑מְתִּי 37:6 2 t., etc., + 3 t. Perfect; Imperfect יַחֲלֹם Isa 29:8 5 t., יַחְלְמוּ Job 39:4 , וַיַּחַלְמוּ Gen 40:5 , יַחֲלֹמ֑וּן Joel 3:1 , נַחַלְמָה Gen 41:11 ; Participle חוֺלֵם Deut 13:4 , חֹלֵם Gen 41:1 ; Deut 13:2 ; 13:6 , חֹלְמִים Psa 126:1 ; — dream: a. of ordinary dreams of sleep Isa 29:8 (twice in verse); Psa 126:1 . b. of dreams with prophetic meaning : of Jacob Gen 28:12 , Joseph 37:5-6 , 9 (twice in verse); 37:10 ; 42:9 , of Pharaoh and his servants 40:5 , 8 ; 41:1 , 5 , 11 (twice in verse); 41:15 (all E, not elsewhere in Hexateuch); of Midianite Judg 7:13 , Nebuchad. Dan 2:1 , 3 , old men in latter days Joel 3:1 . c. of dreams of false prophets Deut 13:2 ; 13:4 ; 13:6 ; Jer 23:25 (twice in verse). Hiph`il Participle , מַחְלְמִים dream (of false prophets, with accusative of congnate meaning with verb) Jer 29:8 (but read חֹלְמִים [ מ by dittograph from אַתֶּם ], Hi Gf Gie Gr).
